integrity: All forty-nine support transitions and the universal inclusion-exclusion count are explicit. A standalone labelled-state simulator and a separate exact symbolic count verified the formulas; neither provides independent external scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Only three-color cyclic automata on labelled nonempty bicliques with synchronous threshold-one updates; no assertions about other graphs or local rules. Qualitative synchronization by graph diameter is prior-known. Individual primitive-orbit basin sizes are not determined.
title: Exact six-class census and one-step oscillatory transients for three-color cyclic dynamics on bicliques
